name: Will my commercial property insurance cover restoration costs?

mainEntity.name: Will my commercial property insurance cover restoration costs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most commercial property insurance policies cover the costs associated with sudden and accidental damage, such as water damage from a burst pipe or fire damage. However, coverage can vary depending on your specific policy and the cause of the damage. We recommend contacting your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage details. First To Respond Restoration can also assist with documentation and direct billing to your insurer to simplify the claims process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial property insurance often covers restoration for sudden damage, but coverage details depend on your policy. We can help with documentation for claims.
